summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — BESI.AS +10%, STMPA.PA +9%, ASM.AS +9%, ASML.AS +9%, PCT.L +9%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (VOD.L -6%, WKL.AS -3%, ORA.PA -2%, KPN.AS -2%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: BESI.AS (+10.23%) — No confirmed same-day catalyst found. Likely continued AI/hybrid-bonding and M&A momentum after Applied Materials lifted its stake to about 20% (Oct 27) and earlier takeover reports. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: BESI is a mid-cap Dutch semiconductor-equipment name listed only on Euronext Amsterdam. Since the move has no clear news trigger, a gap-up or volume filter would also likely have excluded it.

top_movers.suggestion: Add large-cap EU semis (STMPA.PA, ASML.AS, IFX.DE) to the momentum-trader universe, or add a daily scan that admits any STOXX 600 name with a gap of at least +5% on at least 1.5x average volume.

top_movers.catalyst: No confirmed same-day news found. Searches turned up nothing dated 2026-11-24, so this is likely a semiconductor-equipment/AI-capex sector rally rather than a company-specific event.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: ASM.AS is a large-cap Euronext Amsterdam semiconductor-equipment name that no strategy lists. A +9% move with no clear catalyst also looks sector-driven, which gap or news-reactive filters would not flag.
top_movers.suggestion: Add ASM.AS, ASML.AS and BESI.AS to the uk-eu momentum universe as a semis-equipment basket. Also add a sector-breadth trigger that admits peers when ≥2 of them gap up ≥+4% on above-average volume.

top_movers.suggestion: Add large-cap EU semis (ASML.AS, ASM International, BE Semiconductor, STMicro) to the momentum universe, with a sector-breadth trigger that enters when ≥3 semis gap up ≥4% on above-average volume.

top_movers.catalyst: No stock-specific news found for 2026-11-24. PCT is a tech-focused investment trust, so the +8.8% most likely reflects a sharp rally in AI/tech holdings or a narrowing of its NAV discount.
